semantic_profile: L0 static exact-version and supplied-assessment-binding profile; 3 kinds, 28 ordered pairs

checks.evidence: Semantics imports only input types and contains no checker calls; input assessment status is separately supplied data.
Exact 3/21/4 ordered signatures audited against live source hashes; all 28 have kernel-checked positive controls.
All eight source fields retain string shape; constructor mismatch, empty fields, wrong versions, unresolved and misbound assessments reject.
Arbitrary finite Graph and Assertion variables; no size bound or fixture-only premise in the required soundness statements.
Completeness plus an inhabited 3-kind graph, accepted addition, conformance without admission and coexistence with an independent input root.
64 transitive-axiom audits allow standard kernel axioms only; sorry and custom-axiom probes compile but policy rejects them.
checkAddition rechecks the resulting graph; the invalid-old-graph control rejects.
Separately stated required types accept the named theorems; weakened and circular replacements fail type checking.
Source, profile, definitions, checker, theorem, toolchain and imported core-library hashes are recorded; changed inputs require replay and review.
No decoder or HTTP/CLI implementation claimed; P02 aligns draft projections after B00.

criteria.criterion: Fix ordered endpoint pairs, qualifier/reference meanings and the independently stated graph invariant against the captured source slice.
Record semantic/reviewer ownership, the required general soundness statement and the conditions under which the slice has an inhabited valid graph.
Treat the existing companion schemas and APIs as draft projections to be aligned after formalization.

failure_controls.control: Do not define normative validity by a schema validator or a successful checker Boolean.
Do not replace forbidden conformance-to-admission justification with a global prohibition of independently justified admission.

criteria.criterion: Typed identities, exact ordered signatures, qualifiers, references and the graph invariant have independent formal definitions.
The intended theorem quantifies over arbitrary finite supported inputs; all source-interpretation and external-evidence assumptions are explicit.

failure_controls.control: Reject circular validity definitions, assumptions equivalent to the theorem conclusion and permissive unknown-kind escapes.
No parser, host Boolean or identity-binding theorem substitutes for the independently defined semantics.

criteria.criterion: The reference checker consumes the formal typed input directly and has no dependency on JSON decoding or host runtime integration.
Meaningful valid and invalid Lean examples exercise exact pairs, qualifiers, references and the selected graph invariant.

failure_controls.control: Reject permissive fallback, a single-example definition of correctness and a checker whose result defines semantic validity.
A checked executable definition alone is insufficient until P05 establishes its general soundness.

criteria.criterion: Lean checks the exact general theorem with the pinned D00 toolchain and an audited dependency/axiom closure.
Check at least one inhabited valid formal graph so the selected use case is not vacuous.
Review accepts independent semantics and proof scope, including explicit source, parser, hash and compiled-runtime trust boundaries; this closes F0.

failure_controls.control: Reject sorry, unapproved axioms, weakened statements, circular assumptions and a theorem proved only for an example.
Do not claim that formal checker soundness proves arbitrary JSON decoding, authenticated evidence roots or compiled host execution.

trust_boundaries: Lean kernel and pinned core library
deferred: P06 host and source-bound certificate integration
claim_ceiling: General soundness/completeness for the explicit three-kind typed finite input invariant; no JSON, external evidence authentication, crypto, compiled-runtime equivalence or authority admission.
